programme.title: Me and My tourette's
programme.desc: Tourette's syndrome, which manifests itself in involuntary movements and vocal tics, can lead to social exclusion of people affected by it.Participants of a special camp in Victoria hope to improve their functioning.Viewers meet three patients with Tourette's syndrome.Among them is a girl struggling with the difficulties of everyday life, a recently diagnosed man and a teenager who dreams of working in the police.Despite many difficulties, each of them tries to live like other representatives of society.

programme.title: Seven Worlds, One Planet
programme.desc: Antarctica is the coldest and windiest continent.The climate here is harsh, and only the toughest can survive.From Weddell seals crushing the ice with their teeth, to colorful starfish covering the seabed hidden under the ice.Penguin chicks may lose their lives when confronted by killer whales and leopard seals.Meanwhile, starfish and huge worms line the seabed as a feeding spectacle takes place on the surface.Life comes to Antarctica because the ocean surrounding the continent is extremely rich.Thousands of penguins, seals, albatrosses and over a hundred huge whales feast on the krill schools.Unfortunately, the local waters are warming, and as the temperature increases, the future of the local fauna and flora looks more and more uncertain.

programme.title: Dynasties II
programme.desc: The authors present the fate of wild animals that, living in often difficult conditions, persistently fight for the survival of their families.Each episode concerns a representative of a different species and members of its herd.Viewers will learn, among others:the story of the eight-year-old cheetah Kali, a resident of the grassy plains in western Zambia.Despite her relatively old age, the female desperately protects her family, teaching her daughters to be independent.A resident of Kenya, an inexperienced elephant, tries to secure the existence of her twins and unite the herd after the death of the leader.A puma from Patagonia takes care of four cubs alone.The program also features croquets, whose females are fighting an internal fight for dominance, as well as a young meerkat queen and Mac the macaque, trying to maintain his dominant role in the herd and father an offspring, thus initiating his own monkey dynasty.

programme.title: Alexander Armstrong in Sri Lanka
programme.desc: After the economic crisis that occurred in 2022, Sri Lanka is opening up to tourists again.As a result of the pandemic and the suspension of tourist traffic, the country suffered economically.There were riots, including:storming the president's house by 700,000 citizens.Sri Lanka, which until 1972 was called Ceylon, is visited by actor and comedian Alexander Armstrong.He admires the charms of a diverse and multicultural country, which is no stranger to civil wars and natural disasters.He sees ritual exorcisms and is skilled in the ancient martial art of Angampora.He also takes an oil bath and tries to keep up with the Sri Lankan fishermen who fish on stilts.
